name: @even/dev-hud
description: The Dev HUD: jobs, GitHub, and OpenClaw on the glasses. Read-only.

scripts.qr: evenhub qr --ip "$(ipconfig getifaddr "$(route -n get default | awk '/interface:/{print $2}')")" --port 5175 --http
scripts.pack: npm run build && evenhub pack app.json ./dist --output ../../dev-hud.ehpk
